calibration.selection_rule: maximize calibration initially masked token accuracy, then exact sequence recovery, then minimize mean realized forward passes; remaining ties use the lexicographically smallest preregistered configuration

protocol.corruption: prepared once per example and reused by every policy; decoding seeds are also identical across policies
protocol.fixed_policy_budget: fixed_order, fixed_fraction, and confidence use the declared maximum-pass budget

metrics.reconstruction: accuracy only over initially masked tokens
metrics.wall_time: accelerator-synchronized per-example sampler wall time; includes Python overhead and does not establish a speed claim

windows.method: disjoint contiguous windows within the training tail holdout
